name: GraphQL Query Amplification & Batching Auditor
description: High-impact GraphQL query amplification and batching vulnerability auditor for bug bounty hunters. Detects JSON array-based query batching, alias multiplexing amplification, brute-force rate-limit bypasses, and circular relationship depth risks on Apollo, Yoga, and Hasura GraphQL gateways.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

test_array_batching.description: Send JSON array batch queries ([{query: ...}, {query: ...}]) to test batching support

test_alias_amplification.description: Test field alias overloading (e.g. 50 aliases in a single query)

test_circular_depth.description: Probe for recursive relational object expansion (author { posts { author { posts } } })
